items.headline: 16-unit apartment building permitted on Bradford Way
items.summary: A new $1.8 million, 16-unit multi-family building has been permitted at 1803 Bradford Way under developer Bemp. This is one of the larger new-housing permits in the batch, adding a block of units rather than a single-family conversion.

items.headline: New signage points to 'gloo' opening on Olive Avenue
items.summary: A permit for non-illuminated aluminum and window signs reading 'gloo' was issued for 412 Olive Avenue, suggesting a new business moving into the North Ventura mixed-use district.

items.headline: Law firm Cleary Gottlieb signs on for Downtown space
items.summary: A permit was issued for a black aluminum channel-letter sign reading 'Cleary Gottlieb' at 151 University Avenue, indicating the law firm is setting up in Downtown Palo Alto.

items.headline: Three prefab ADUs permitted near one Rubino Drive building
items.summary: Three separate prefab ADU permits (#121, #123, #125), each valued around $117,000, were issued the same day near Building 'D' at 3180 Rubino Drive as part of the EPR Villa Homes project. The identical scope and shared timing suggest a coordinated rollout of prefabricated units across the property.

items.headline: Council to place business tax overhaul on ballot
items.summary: The council is considering a resolution to ask voters to replace Milpitas' current business tax with a tiered gross receipts system, where tax bills would scale with a company's actual sales rather than a flat rate. The city says about 85% of local businesses have small enough gross receipts that they'd be protected under the new tiers.
